scope: Later local stages 2 and 3 plus confirmation acceptance; fixed before reading any Stage1 performance summary or running later stages.
development_gate: Same conservative screening as Stage1: no increase in failures in any pool/composition/mechanism stratum; mean penalized delta negative in every pool/composition design group. Retain current module if no eligible alternative.
development_ranking: Choose the alternative minimizing the largest pool/composition mean delta; inspect per-mechanism effects and retained worst-regression logs.
confirmation_gate: No increased failures or hull-invariant violations. Reject an efficiency change if any pool/composition design group has a positive paired 95% bootstrap lower bound for cost change (clear deterioration in that group); otherwise retain the frozen development choice for fresh official validation with uncertainty explicitly reported.
confirmation_limit: This is a one-time accept/reject of the frozen choice, never a source for selecting another setting. No claim of improvement follows merely from passing this gate. Pointwise exploratory intervals are not multiplicity-adjusted.
official_candidate_rule: At most one final changed policy per problem; do not fabricate improvement or compare identically configured arms if every stage retains the original baseline.
